Container.Name: OpenFamily
Container.Overview: OpenFamily is a family organizer for your own server: a shared calendar with reminders, tasks and chores with a rewards system for kids, shopping lists updated live on every phone, meal planning with a recipe book, a family budget, a kiosk mode for a wall tablet and an optional AI assistant. It has an Android app, a documented API with webhooks, and integrations with Home Assistant, Gladys Assistant, Mealie, Grocy and Nextcloud. The interface is available in eight languages.[br][br] This one container holds the web interface, the API and its PostgreSQL database. There is nothing to prepare: the secrets are generated on the first start and kept in the data folder. Start it, open the Web UI and create your account.[br][br] Everything to back up is in the data folder.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The address of OpenFamily in a browser and in the Android app: http://UNRAID-IP:PORT

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database and the secrets generated on the first start. This is the folder to back up.

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Leave on true to create your account, then set to false: after that only people invited from the Family page can create one.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open OpenFamily at, e.g. https://family.example.org. Needed for single sign-on, and when e-mail links show the wrong address behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Mail server for invitation and password reset e-mails. Empty = no e-mail is sent; invitations still work by sharing their link.

Config.Name: Mail From
Config.Description: Sender of the e-mails, e.g. OpenFamily <family@example.org>

Config.Name: SSO Issuer URL
Config.Description: Single sign-on (OpenID Connect) issuer URL. Empty = off. Redirect URI to register at your provider: [Public URL]/api/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: SSO Button Label
Config.Description: Shown as 'Continue with ...' on the sign-in page

Config.Name: Allow Password Sign-in
Config.Description: Set to false for an SSO-only server (ignored while SSO is not configured)
